hypothesis: A credit-eligible physical GRID10 base path should use the exact ten simultaneously-live held-S1 cohort packets as the immutable evidence set, bind each source to deterministic current membership/health authority and parent-observed process identity, validate consumed-snapshot receipts against the one starting S1 identity, and commit the entire cohort through one coordinator-authorized atomic fan-in or an equally explicit provenance-preserving derivation protocol.
counterhypothesis: Held-S1 physical proof plus separately tested atomic fan-in and membership fixtures may be sufficient by compositional reasoning without a fused exact-source executable. This audit rejects that promotion rule because executable evidence at one component boundary does not prove cross-component causal composition or rule out a splice between different cohorts/authority identities.
